name: official-verl-grpo-gsm8k-smoke
purpose: Run the official verl GRPO path before reproducing it in mini-verl.

task.response_contract: Follow the upstream GSM8K prompt and end with `#### <integer>`; score the final integer using verl's rule reward.

promotion_gates: Official verl revision is captured in official_verl/verl.lock.json.
The official repository contains a GRPO example or config selected by the operator.
Reward is neither all zero nor all one on the smoke rollout.
Metrics include reward, KL, response length, and a saved checkpoint.
The held-out verifier evaluation runs before and after training.
